races.paceDynamic: Poetic Twist is the only confirmed front runner in this 18-runner maiden hurdle and should be allowed to dictate terms uncontested through the early stages. With most rivals showing hold-up or unknown styles, and several having fading tendencies, the pace is likely to be steady rather than searching. The lack of early pressure will create a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial, with the field bunching up approaching the final bend before a sprint finish unfolds. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can get into contention early, as hold-up horses will struggle to make ground in a slowly-run race with 18 runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Poetic Twist dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite gets an uncontested lead and finds the soft ground to his liking.
scenarios.body: Elliott's charge can exploit his class advantage with tactical speed from the front, controlling the tempo throughout. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to quicken when it matters and hold off challengers up the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent challenger strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers can track Poetic Twist and outstay him in testing ground.
scenarios.body: Crystabel or Echinacea can sit just behind the leader and use their tactical positioning advantage. The soft going becomes a leveller, allowing lesser-rated horses to close the gap on class through stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse springs surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and a closer gets a dream run through.
scenarios.body: Strong Contender or Sarah's Express benefit from a truly-run race where stamina matters more than class. The large field creates opportunities for patient riders to find gaps and make late progress.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete longshot upset
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Twist fails to handle the ground or makes jumping errors under pressure.
scenarios.body: The race opens up dramatically with the favourite struggling, allowing an unfancied runner like Idomything to transfer flat form. Chaos in a big field creates opportunities for those at huge odds to sneak through.

Echinacea's flat form transfer to hurdles is key with multiple place efforts at longer trips

races.paceDynamic: Butterfly Mountain is the only confirmed front-runner in this 18-runner maiden hurdle field, likely to get an uncontested lead with most rivals adopting prominent or hold-up tactics. With soft ground favoring sustained galloping over quick acceleration, the lone leader should dictate a steady tempo that builds gradually. Master Haku, Appy Getaway, and Bulgaden Castle can track the pace in the second rank, while multiple hold-up horses like the Flat recruits will need gaps and momentum late. This race shape strongly favors prominent runners who can position handily and kick when the pace lifts, as they avoid both the exposure of leading and the traffic problems facing back-markers in a large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Master Haku or Appy Getaway can track Butterfly Mountain's steady pace and strike approaching the final flight.
scenarios.body: The soft ground suits sustained galloping over sharp acceleration, allowing handy horses to build momentum without facing the exposure of leading or needing late gaps. Elliott's Master Haku has proven hurdles form while Appy Getaway brings winning bumper credentials.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Maiden Hurdle Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the newcomers like Cullagh Lad or Tribal shows natural jumping ability and benefits from the steady pace.
scenarios.body: First-time hurdlers often surprise in maidens when connections find the right opportunity, and the uncontested lead creates an ideal learning environment. The Mahler bloodline of Cullagh Lad or Harzand breeding of Tribal could translate to jumping prowess.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Springs Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and one of the Flat recruits like Small Fry finds gaps in the closing stages.
scenarios.body: O'Brien's Small Fry has the highest Flat rating among the newcomers and proven stamina from the Irish Cesarewitch, potentially suiting this trip if the race sets up for closers. Soft ground could help his stamina-laden profile overcome the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Butterfly Mountain improves dramatically from previous efforts and the field fails to mount serious pressure.
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead scenario occasionally produces shock winners in weak maidens, especially when the pace-setter gets confidence from jumping well. However, Butterfly Mountain's poor recent form makes this the least likely outcome despite the tactical advantage.

Watch for market moves on the newcomers Cullagh Lad and Tribal as stable confidence indicators

Ground conditions may worsen further, potentially favoring the stamina-heavy Flat recruits over speed horses

races.paceDynamic: Becasse and Wholelotofbusiness will set a reasonable tempo from the front, with both capable of sustaining their efforts without excessive early pressure in this large field. The majority of runners are hold-up horses who will need the race to develop, creating potential traffic problems and relying on the pace-setters to provide a strong enough gallop. With 11 of the 14 runners carrying hold-up or midfield styles, the early leaders won't face much pressure until the final stages. This race shape clearly favours the prominent/leading horses who can avoid the scramble and have clear sailing throughout.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Becasse and Wholelotofbusiness maintain their positions without interference
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows them to dictate terms and kick clear when the hold-up brigade are still organizing behind them. The soft ground suits their stamina-based profiles and they can exploit positional advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up traffic chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large field bunches up turning for home creating a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses get in each other's way while the best handlers find gaps late. Class and experience become decisive factors in navigating the crowded finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If She Is Electric or Sopelana track the leaders perfectly
scenarios.body: They get an ideal tow behind the pace-setters before producing superior finishing kicks. The 11-year-old She Is Electric uses her experience while Sopelana's recent Punchestown win gives him confidence.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider emerges late

races.paceDynamic: Shadys Lady will take this along as the sole confirmed front-runner, setting a sustainable gallop without pressure early. The real congestion comes behind with Carry On Heidi, Joshua's Daylami, Katie Daniels, and Ladiam all wanting prominent positions - this creates a bunching issue approaching the business end with traffic problems likely 2-3 out. The relatively honest pace should set up perfectly for the hold-up horses like Dameauscottlestown, Cobra Queen, and Elsannah to unleash late kicks. This race shape strongly favours horses that can settle and produce sustained finishes from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses get tangled up in traffic 2-3 out as expected
scenarios.body: The patient riders on the hold-up horses can pick their way through and time their challenges perfectly. The honest early gallop from Shadys Lady gives them the perfect setup to unleash telling late runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Running Pays Off
scenarios.trigger: If Shadys Lady maintains her gallop and the field fails to close
scenarios.body: Her sustainable pace becomes a winning weapon as she keeps finding when challenged. The soft ground may slow down the closers enough for her to hold on grimly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners avoids the traffic and gets first run
scenarios.body: They can steal a march while the hold-up horses are still finding racing room behind the struggling pack. Carry On Heidi or Katie Daniels could exploit their forward positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Shadys Lady stops quickly and no one takes up the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. This chaos scenario opens the door for any runner with pace to burn.

races.paceDynamic: Made In The Woods is the sole confirmed front-runner and will lead uncontested from the outset, setting a sustainable gallop over this marathon trip on soft ground. With only It's Time Again and Mr Dibbs likely to race prominently behind the leader, the bulk of this 19-runner field will settle in midfield or towards the rear. The lack of early pace pressure means Made In The Woods can dictate fractions and potentially steal a march, while the large field and soft conditions will create a strung-out affair where those held up face traffic problems. This tactical scenario strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable scramble behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Made In The Woods gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The veteran can exploit his uncontested advantage and soft ground preference to build an unassailable lead. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground through the packed field on testing ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and hold-up horses get racing room in the straight
scenarios.body: Quality hold-up performers like Dolly Watkins and Atlantic Gamble can unleash finishing kicks despite traffic concerns. The soft ground plays to their stamina reserves over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Win
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders maintain a solid gallop but fade in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Horses racing in fourth to eighth position can strike the perfect balance between avoiding trouble and staying close enough to pounce. This tactical positioning proves optimal in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Outsider Shock
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders all disappoint and a forgotten runner emerges
scenarios.body: A lightly-weighted improver like La Tene or Yoursimplythebest produces career-best efforts when others falter. The competitive handicap nature allows for surprise winners from the pack.

watchPoints.text: Made In The Woods getting too easy a lead in front - if he's allowed to bowl along unchallenged he could steal this from the front
Traffic problems in the straight with 19 runners on soft ground - hold-up horses like Dolly Watkins and Atlantic Gamble need clear runs
It's Time Again and Mr Dibbs for fitness first time back - both have been off extended spells and may need the run
La Tene building on recent Clonmel third - lightly raced and could be ahead of the handicapper for in-form trainer
Multiple horses with fade warnings under pressure - expect several to weaken tamely in the closing stages despite being prominent early

races.paceDynamic: Mi Lucky Cailin will make the running from Lady Bluebird, with no other confirmed pace pressers in this 14-runner field. This sets up a sustainable tempo through the early stages, allowing the leaders to dictate terms without severe pressure. The large field of hold-up horses including Survivors Sister, It's Never Simple, and Sky And Sand will need to navigate traffic problems in the straight. This tactical scenario strongly favours prominent racers and those that can secure good early positions over pure hold-up horses who face positioning nightmares.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Setup
scenarios.trigger: If Mi Lucky Cailin and Lady Bluebird control the tempo without fierce early pressure
scenarios.body: The leaders get an uncontested run to the business end where their fitness tells, while the hold-up brigade gets trapped behind the large field. Early positioning proves decisive as traffic becomes the main obstacle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Class
scenarios.trigger: If the large field of hold-up horses creates a cavalry charge from the back
scenarios.body: Superior horses like Survivors Sister and It's Never Simple find gaps when it matters most, using their class edge to overcome positioning disadvantages. The sustained pace suits their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Two Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Mi Lucky Cailin and Lady Bluebird go too fast trying to shake off the field
scenarios.body: The pace setters tie up in the final half-mile, creating opportunities for the best-positioned hold-up horses who avoided early trouble. Those with tactical speed like Sky And Sand benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and a forgotten horse gets a dream run
scenarios.body: A lightly-weighted runner like Johnny Cakes or Without Exception capitalizes on the perfect setup, sneaking through on the rail while favorites get blocked. Weight relief becomes the decisive factor.

runners_data.spotlight: Price reduced to 5,000euros at three; dam unraced half-sister to three winners including Minella Awards (smart 2m4f-3m1f hurdle/chase); stable 0-33 in bumpers last five seasons.

runners_data.name: Stanger
runners_data.comment: First foal by Order Of St George; hooded on debut for top yard; shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: First foal by Order Of St George; dam useful 2m2f-2m5f hurdle/chase winner, sister to 2m6f hurdle winner Deluxe Range, out of unraced half-sister to 2m hurdle winner Good Thyne Diva; hooded on debut for top yard; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Senorita Diana
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to 12.3f/12.5f Flat (RPR 68) and 2m hurdle winner Spanish John; watch
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to 12.3f/12.5f Flat (RPR 68) and 2m hurdle winner Spanish John; dam 1m1f Flat winner (76)/maiden hurdler, out of half-sister to Italian St Leger winner Spanish Hidalgo; stable 1-9 in bumpers this season; watch.

runners_data.name: Mike Des Mottes
runners_data.comment: Good fourth on debut; the one to beat with some experience under his belt
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off 4-1 for his debut at Leopardstown (2m, soft to heavy) when beaten around 4l into fourth of eight; sets a good standard and likely to improve; the one to beat with the benefit of experience under his belt; stable 1-45 in bumpers.
